system.description:
Cyber Cost: 4

Gain Full Access to Blackwall. When you roll with Fear using a Blackwall card, gain 1 Corruption, max 3. Before a Blackwall roll, spend any Corruption to roll that many d6s and add them to the roll. If you spend 3 Corruption and succeed, one affected target marks 1 Stress, becomes temporarily Degraded, and can’t benefit from connected systems while Degraded. Then mark a Stress and the GM gains a Fear.
